result.note: Additional relevant historical measurement from this same Qwen3-4B project: p4-qwen-ttft-a/trial-9cc583939d was a real automatic joint gate/up projection-packing candidate at 72 phase/module sites. At B=1, prompt=256, new_tokens=32 it executed the candidate sites, but full logits had about 27.2% out-of-tolerance elements and a reported maximum difference 1.96875; identical greedy tokens were not sufficient. This is a different workload and implementation, not a proof that every packing strategy fails and not an attribution of the error to one subchange. The complete prior result and candidate are supplied as inputs/related-packing-result.json and inputs/related-packing-candidate.py for inspection. Use it as historical negative evidence when considering related mechanisms, keep the original external quality unchanged, and choose actual groups from the current discovery. There is no prescribed target/operator or implementation. The current effective eager decoder bundle must remain active for the composition experiment.
